name: rename_repository
description: Rename a repository the person named, to `new_name` (the same owner). GitHub keeps redirecting the old address. It needs the bypass access tier, and GitHub's own rules and the permissions of your credentials decide whether it happens: if it refuses you get its words, and you tell the person.

repo.description: The repository the person named: `owner/name`, or its address

new_name.description: The new name: letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, at most 100 characters
